This small maize plot is close to home and I know maize responds well to fertilizer, so I will buy a bit of DAP and urea from the cooperative — not the full package they recommend, because cash is tight, but enough to make a difference. I also have some manure from our animals that I will spread before planting. Since I am planting maize and I learned in school that the new varieties yield more, I will try to get improved seed if the cooperative has it this year. The plot is small so my wife and I can manage most of the work ourselves, and I will only hire a couple of days of help for weeding when the rains come heavy.
